summary: Sigma Lithium Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a September 4, 2026 press release announcing that its common shares, represented by CHESS Depositary Interests (CDIs), commenced trading on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) under ticker SAU as a Foreign Exempt Issuer. Each CDI corresponds to one fully paid common share on a 1:1 ratio. The listing broadens access to Australian capital markets for lithium investors while shares continue trading on Nasdaq and TSX-V. This is a routine dual-listing event without special-situation attributes, requiring no board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms.
